description: Survey-weighted logistic regression coefficients for crash outcome 'fatal_cc'
population: CRSS police-reported crashes 2016-2024 where the complete-case outcome is determined (crashes with a person of unknown severity are excluded unless the outcome is already met)
method: Pseudo-ML logistic regression; Taylor-linearised variance (25 strata, 67 PSUs); model A = PRE_CRASH covariates (mutually adjusted), model B = A + crash type + number of vehicles
